svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: N — Stained glass · Thrills & Chills round-4 art concept
svg.text: Every object is cut into jewel glass held by dark lead.
Light comes from behind: each piece glows bright at the
centre and deepens to its edge. Sunbeams cross the park.

g.text: Piece = radial fill (light centre) + 3 px lead.
Faces are cut 1-3 times; cylinders into staves.
Ground = jittered half-tile mosaic, by terrain.
Shading = darker glass, never a cast shadow.
